tension.T-: Force out pages just to prove motion
tension.A+: Let the idea mature before testing it
tension.A-: Keep it only imagined, never risked

transformation.Ac: Arrange capture, incubation, and drafting steps so the idea moves from promise toward protection.
transformation.Re: Observe how timed, low-stakes slots turn protecting the idea into visible, if imperfect, pages.
transformation.Ac+: Replace forced output with a staged practice: capture, incubate, then draft when the idea is ready.
transformation.Ac-: Pages pile up imperfect and unseen, idea still shielded, never risked to any eye but yours.
transformation.Re+: Watch their timed, low-stakes slots show that showing up matters more than being ready.
transformation.Re-: Admiring their timed sessions from afar, you still keep the idea only imagined, unrisked.

utterance: Is it normal to feel nothing when your startup gets acquired?

tension.A: I feel nothing about the sale
tension.T+: The missing feeling shows me what mattered
tension.T-: I'm failing by not feeling the 'right' thing
tension.A+: I let feelings surface in their own time
tension.A-: Numbness means there's nothing here to process

transformation.Ac: Implementation here means routinely checking in on feeling as the sale moves from 'should feel big' toward actual numbness.
transformation.Re: Detection here means scanning their daily one-line notes for patterns before assuming numbness means failure.
transformation.Ac+: Each morning, pause and simply note what you feel—no scoring against what you "should."
transformation.Ac-: The daily noting ritual, repeated without insight, turns into evidence that confirms numbness means nothing mattered.
transformation.Re+: Notice what their simple daily lines reveal about what actually mattered through the sale.
transformation.Re-: Reading their lines only to measure whether your own feelings match some expected standard.

tension.T-: Forcing it before either is ready
tension.A+: Preparing so the talk lands well
tension.A-: Delaying until the moment never comes

transformation.Ac: Stepping in to shift the conversation from indefinite postponement toward an actual, chosen moment.

transformation.Re+: Let the approaching shared event signal that drifting silence must now resolve into honest words.
transformation.Re-: Noticing the deadline approach becomes its own comfort, replacing any actual move to prepare or speak.
